title: Don’t Hesitate, Just Start!
body:
I love this app and how the management team was so responsive to my needs!

I struggled with keeping up with all of my habits mentally and was looking for a system that can ease my difficulties in remembering the different habits that i want to do daily. After exploring different apps, I found out that this is the easiest for me to navigate and all the different configurations were really accessible too! Aside from that, the aesthetics were also really pleasing for the eyes and you even have a daily quote to keep you going! 

If you are looking to become the best version of yourself, being happier and successful, those are habits that need to be cultivate. and guess what? this habit tracker app is really the one for you. it can also show how you feel on average and that is really important for me as someone who needs to consciously regulate my feelings and emotions to perform better. 

so don’t hesitate and just start by downloading habit tracker app to help create a self image you believe in :)

title: incredibly nifty - can’t thank the developers enough 🙌🏻
body:
1. Tons of icons, preset colors and alert tones to already choose from (so. much. customisability.)
2. Daily, yearly, monthly overview on a nifty bujo-like screen for a summary
3. Widgets - score! How many habit apps have widgets?
4. Incredibly minimalist and aesthetic
5. Developers are super responsive & receptive to feedback
That only scratches the surface, really. Tried pretty much every lesser-known habit tracker on the App Store. Nothing else seems to compare with this app. Bought the premium version without hesitation. 

Some suggestions for improvement:
1. Slight glitches with notifications that weren’t showing up for some habits for a couple of days
2. Pop up alert for units of measure when creating a new habit takes an awkwardly long while to disappear and you can’t click away
3. Color picker for custom color selections, alternative fonts
4. Habits to break & long-term goal setting feature, perhaps?

Seriously. Support the developers already.
